# Mortise

> Self-hosted Railway-style deploy platform for Kubernetes. Deploy anything, own everything.

Mortise is an open-source platform that gives teams Railway-style deploys on their own Kubernetes cluster. Users connect a git repo or pick an OCI image; Mortise handles builds, deploys, domains, TLS, DNS, env vars, volumes, preview environments, and service bindings. Kubernetes is fully abstracted from the user.

One operator. One Helm chart. No SaaS bill.

## Key concepts

- **Project**: top-level grouping of apps and environments (cluster-scoped CRD)
- **App**: the user-facing workload resource — source type is `git` or `image`
- **Environment**: named deploy targets per app (production, staging, etc.)
- **Binding**: connects one App to another; auto-generates HOST, PORT, and URL env vars for the bound service
- **Preview Environment**: per-PR ephemeral stacks triggered by git webhooks
- **PlatformConfig**: cluster-scoped singleton for domain, TLS issuer, storage class
